core_idea: Dieci Assoc. South Section 4 Rodion is a Tank — **Discard** specialist — cycle skills intentionally to build Insight/Erudition, then cash out with the powered skill line.
playstyle_guide:
- Discard to build **Insight**, then fire the powered skill set.

**S1 — Illuminate Thy Vacuity** (BP 3, CP +2, x3): rolls — low 3, high 9 (Extremely Low).
- Gain (Insight x 5% of Max HP) Shield if this Skill is Discarded ; [On Use] If Insight is 2 or higher, gain Coin Power by (Insight -1)
- Gain (Insight x 5% of Max HP) Shield if this Skill is Discarded; [On Use] If Insight is 2 or higher, gain Coin Power by (Insight -1)

**S2 — Weight of Knowledge** (BP 3, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 3, high 15 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Gain (Insight x 10% of Max HP) Shield if this Skill is Discarded | [On Use] Discard 1 Skill of the lowest rank in all of this unit's Skill Slots.

**S3 — Excruciating Study** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Gain (Insight x 20% of Max HP) Shield if this Skill is Discarded | [On Use] Discard 2 Skills of the lowest ranks in all of this unit's Skill Slots.

Combat passive — **Incandescent Enlightenment**: Gain Blunt DMG Up next turn based on the damage that this unit took this turn.
  - (Shield damage included in the calculation. Maxes out when taking damage equal to 25% of Max HP at turn start.
  - Max Blunt DMG Up gained by this effect: 5).

Combat passive — **Missionary of Knowledge**: 1 ally with the highest Max HP gains Blunt DMG Up next turn based on the damage that they took this turn.
  - (Shield damage included in the calculation. Maxes out when taking damage equal to 15% of Max HP at turn start.
  - Max Blunt DMG Up gained by this effect: 3).
team_suggestions: Best placed in a Sinking-focused team — teammates that apply or extend Sinking increase this kit's damage ceiling.
- Pair with identities whose support passives inflict statuses this kit stacks or scales off.
